Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Tax Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Tax Services provides comprehensive tax preparation and accounting services, specializing in individual tax returns and bookkeeping for small businesses. Our operations are conducted from a secure, office-based environment where we implement robust cybersecurity measures, including multi-factor authentication and regular data backups. We maintain a strong risk management culture, with minimal prior claims and a commitment to professional development and compliance with industry standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2022, a data breach occurred due to a phishing attack, resulting in unauthorized access to client information. The estimated costs for forensic investigation and client notification were approximately $10,000. The claim was settled in March 2022 and marked as resolved. On 06/25/2023, a printer malfunction caused water damage to office equipment, leading to repair costs of $5,000. This incident is currently under review for final reimbursement, expected to be resolved by August 2023. Total losses incurred amount to $15,000.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system installed, office secured with monitored alarm, and regular security audits performed.
